items.source: Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
items.translation: 已弃用，即将移除：此 API 元素将在未来版本中移除。

items.source: Note: Unlike FileSystemResource, when building relative resources via createRelative(String), the relative path will be built underneath the given root: for example, Paths.get("C:/dir1/"), relative path "dir2" → "C:/dir1/dir2"!
items.translation: 注意：与FileSystemResource不同，通过createRelative(String)构建相对资源时，相对路径将在给定的根目录之下构建：例如，Paths.get("C:/dir1/")，相对路径"dir2" → "C:/dir1/dir2"！

items.source: This implementation creates a PathResource, applying the given path relative to the path of the underlying file of this resource descriptor.
items.translation: 此实现会创建一个PathResource类，并将给定路径应用为相对于此资源描述符底层文件的路径。

items.source: Note: As of 5.1, Path support is also available in FileSystemResource, applying Spring's standard String-based path transformations but performing all operations via the Files API. This PathResource is effectively a pure java.nio.path.Path based alternative with different createRelative behavior.
items.translation: 注意：自 5.1 版本起，Path 支持也可在 FileSystemResource 中使用， 它应用 Spring 标准的基于字符串的路径转换，但通过 Files API 执行所有操作。 此 PathResource 本质上是一个基于纯 java.nio.path.Path 的替代方案，具有不同的 createRelative 行为。

items.translation: 此实现始终指示一个文件。

items.source:
This implementation checks whether the underlying file is marked as readable
(and corresponds to an actual file with content, not to a directory).
items.translation: 此实现检查底层文件是否标记为可读（且对应于包含内容的实际文件，而非目录）。

items.source:
This implementation checks whether the underlying file is marked as writable
(and corresponds to an actual file with content, not to a directory).
items.translation: 此实现会检查底层文件是否被标记为可写（且对应的是包含内容的实际文件，而非目录）。

items.source: This implementation returns the underlying file's timestamp.
items.translation: 此实现返回底层文件的最后修改时间戳。
